app.name: Universal Player
settings.heading: Player Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage auto-replace, auto episode switch, watch history, and local storage.
settings.playbackBehaviorDesc: These settings are saved immediately and applied to pages opened afterward.
settings.autoReplaceDesc: Automatically mount Universal Player on supported video pages.
settings.autoChangeDesc: When switching episodes or videos in the same tab, reload the current address automatically.
settings.historyEnabledDesc: Save progress, cover, title, and episode by video URL. When off, records are not added or updated.
settings.appearanceDesc: Switch interface language and black / white color themes.
settings.languageDesc: Switch the display language for settings, popup, and history pages.
settings.themeDesc: Switch between pure black and pure white themes.
settings.storageWarning: Storage usage is above 80%. Consider deleting unused history records.
settings.storageCritical: Storage is almost full. Delete some history or reset extension data so new progress can still be saved.
settings.clearHint: Resetting all extension data deletes settings, watch history, and player replace state.
settings.clearConfirm: Delete all settings, watch history, and replace state? This cannot be undone.
settings.clearDone: All extension data has been reset
popup.heading: Universal Player
popup.statusWaitingBackground: Waiting for page info from background
popup.footnote: Playback UI is always rendered from player/index.html.
popup.clickToInit: Click Start replace to initialize the player
popup.pageNotEligible: This page does not meet replace conditions
popup.backgroundUnsupported: Background judged this page ineligible for replace
popup.originalRestored: The site player has been restored
runtime.CANNOT_READ_TAB: Unable to read the current tab
runtime.NO_ADAPTER: No installed site adapter matches this URL
runtime.PAGE_ELIGIBLE: This page is eligible for replace
runtime.URL_CHANGED_DURING_INITIALIZATIO: Page URL changed during initialization; ignored stale result
runtime.STALE_PAGE_CONTEXT: Page URL changed; canceled the stale initialization task
runtime.EMPTY_RESULT: The page returned no execution result
runtime.PLAYER_RESTORED: The original site player has been restored
runtime.PLAYER_ALREADY_MOUNTED: Universal Player overlay is already running
runtime.UNSUPPORTED_URL: This page does not meet replace conditions
runtime.UNSUPPORTED_STRUCTURE: The current page structure is not supported
history.heading: Watch History
history.summary: {count} video records. Click any episode to return to the original page.
history.storageWarning: Extension storage usage is above 80%. Consider deleting unused records.
history.storageCritical: Extension storage is almost full. Delete some history or new progress may fail to save.
history.empty: No watch history yet. Progress appears here after playing for more than 2 seconds.
history.clearConfirm: Delete all watch history? This cannot be undone.
